name: High Sierra Camps: May Lake to Vogelsang
notes: Representative High Sierra Camps corridor using the May Lake, Vogelsang, and Lyell Canyon permit areas. Yosemite permits are trailhead-specific; the OSM camp point is a planning anchor, not a reservation for a High Sierra Camp bed.

name: Yosemite Valley to Vogelsang
notes: Representative Yosemite Valley / Merced corridor toward Vogelsang. Camping locations beyond the backpackers campground are generally selected legally in the wilderness; consult the NPS trailhead map and minimum-camping-distance rules.

name: Glen Aulin and Tuolumne Meadows
notes: Representative Tuolumne high-country corridor. The NPS wilderness permit trailhead and camping restrictions govern the itinerary; this app uses mapped trail anchors for planning mileage.

name: Hetch Hetchy to Lake Eleanor
notes: Representative northern Yosemite wilderness access corridor. Verify Hetch Hetchy road hours, permit station access, and current water/route conditions before travel.
